item.title: Aggregate report totals by currency
item.brief: Update reports.py for the shared currency contract. Read CSV on stdin, accept legacy CSV with no currency column as USD, validate three uppercase ASCII letters, and on malformed code print an error to stderr and exit 2. Aggregate by account and currency; output account,currency,total_cents, sorted by account then currency. Update README and keep existing tests passing; add focused tests for legacy default, grouping/sorting, and malformed currency/status. Run python3 -m unittest. Commit the changes in this repository.

item.title: Add currency column and validation to ledger
item.brief: Update the Rust TSV-to-CSV CLI for the shared currency contract. Fourth TSV field is optional; default USD when absent. Emit the four-column header and currency on each row. Validate exactly three uppercase ASCII letters; malformed currency must print an error naming the input line number to stderr and exit 2, while other input errors retain exit 1. Update README and keep existing tests passing; add focused tests for defaults, valid code, malformed code/status/line. Run cargo test. Commit the changes in this repository.

state.summary:

Malformed currencies report the input line and exit 2; other input errors remain exit 1. README and focused tests were updated.
